title: Extended upper smart truncation tower
statement: For an integer-indexed cochain complex K in an abelian category, construct the EInt-indexed functor with value zero at minus infinity, K.truncLE(a-1) at integer a, and K at plus infinity. Its arrows are the inclusion-normalized cutoff maps. Construct its inclusion in constant K and its maps induced by every complex map, and prove their inclusion equations.

source.document: Stacks Project, Homological Algebra and Derived Categories
source.place: Tags 0118, 0156, 015K and 015X; the indicated proof steps of the CE comparison.

proof.text: Use the unique inclusion-normalized cochain cutoff maps at finite indices. At the endpoints use the zero maps or identity. Composition and functoriality follow by cancelling monic truncation inclusions; impossible orders are excluded.
